observations.behavior: Native issue checks supportKeyManagement, requests CSR with renewal=false, passes CSR to RA issuance and saves returned pushAttributes plus metadata.
Native renewal checks persisted nonempty CSR/push attributes and supportKeyManagement, then requests a renewal CSR and renews through Core.
generateCsrLocation passes locationAttributes, csrAttributes and renewal to the Entity Provider using its persisted entityInstanceUuid.
Delayed push uses saved certificate-location pushAttributes and public leaf certificate content; withKey and returned metadata update the Core association.
Immediate push sends leaf, X.509 type, locationAttributes and saved pushAttributes, then stores withKey and certificate metadata.
Inventory synchronization replaces per-certificate CSR/push attributes from the returned Location DTO, so native associations must survive synchronization.
